Watcom shadow-pointer walk (two-step form) — `pCVar5` is advanced into scratch `pCVar6`, then rebound via a later `pCVar5 = pCVar6;`. Functionally identical to the single-line self-update; replace `pCVar5->some_field[0]` reads with direct indexing on the original pointer and drop both the advance line and the rebind.

'pCVar3[1].base.base.create_event + 0x1c' walks 1 x sizeof(CEnemy) (0xc268) + offsetof(base.base.create_event) (0x78) + 0x1c = 0xc2fc, which is exactly offsetof(CBatman, part_indices[11]). Ghidra had no CBatman type here and reached the field by index arithmetic; write it as ((CBatman *)pCVar3)->part_indices[11] (§de-pun/§12). Ambiguous: CDemnfolk::bone_indices, CDjien::boxes, CDraculaBride::freaky_timer also has a field there — confirm the real class from the .asm before rewriting.
